novelty_boundary: Prior work diagnoses sensitivity to redundant feature blocks and retrains essential-only GRU/CLIP readers.
Our exact rotation-equivalence intervention preserves both represented rotations and all other blocks.
MARDM additive/replacement block noise is not an exact-equivalence control and does not register equal total L2 across unequal blocks.
Our signed natural deltas test within-rotation noncanonicality only, not all redundant feature errors or their diffusion-noise mechanism.
Rotation-only sign representations cannot discard the whole rotation block while retaining their movement input.
